name: Shiosai Resort
description: Shiosai Resort is a calm, direct-booking family seaside resort theme designed for coastal hotel stays. Built with a high-key film-grain aesthetic, it features beachfront room showcases, seasonal packages, daily tide schedules, and dedicated family amenities. Every room and chapter faces the sea, offering clear pricing and a straightforward reservation process.
